body.name: \(\pi^\dagger\)
body.construction: Set \(W_1\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(1/2)\). For \(2\le t\le8\), assign treatment with probability \(p_t^\dagger=3/4\) when \(Y_{t-1}^{\mathrm{obs}}\ge0\) and \(p_t^\dagger=1/4\) otherwise. Its pathwise assignment factor is \(g_{\pi^\dagger}(w,y)=2^{-1}\prod_{t=2}^8p_t^\dagger(y)^{w_t}\{1-p_t^\dagger(y)\}^{1-w_t}\).
